speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help me understand what you are dealing with, could you tell me when the rash first appeared and if it seems to be spreading or changing?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis.

I see the infant is a 4-day-old with a generalized rash appearing 1 day after birth, and the mother has a history of gonorrhea, though it was treated years ago. To confirm the diagnosis, I will need to see the rash and check for eye or joint involvement. REQUEST IMAGES: [Skin_rash_close_up]. REQUEST TEST: Gram_stain_of_skin_pus. REQUEST TEST: Blood_culture. REQUEST TEST: Joint_aspiration_if_swollen_joints_present.
